qa.question:
I have a project for a local business in Russia and i'm looking to optimize their website (WP) for Yandex. I don't have much experience with this but from what I gather its kinda similar to optimization for Google.
From what I gathered the important things for Yandex are (in that order) : Hosting and websie loading speed and accessibility, domain location (better to use .ru), user visits and engagement, meta data optimization, page tags/title tags, no duplication, internal links (key worded), external links (only of they bring traffic) and text length (200-500 wrds.).
Am I missing something here?
Any resources or tools you can recommend specifically for Yandex? (i speak Russian as well)
Or some Google SEO tools that can definately be used for both?
Maybe some good tutorials on this topic?

answer.text: Hi. As far as I know, the algo for ranking in Yandex is pretty similar to what Google does. Practically, you have to be careful at the about same things. One thing you should also add to your list: backlinks profile. And try to clean it as much as possible. Even if you are optimising for Yandex, it doesnt mean you cannot use tools such as Google Search Console or Bing Webmaster tools (I think Yandex webmaster doesnt provide so many things). They will probably give you some interesting hints. Also, I think that some of the most important stuff in SEO nowadays are: make sure all bots can access your content (technically) - all important pages and all important content on pages (for example, if your website uses JS, rendering can become an issue) quality content and reduce duplicate and thin content optimize crawl budget have a clean, natural backlinks profile have a really good UX and website speed offer as much relevant information as possible regarding: products, services any additional services, FAQs etc. do not create a page for every query you want to target (for example, do not use different categories of products for really similar products if they can be listed in the same page) have a good content marketing strategy (for blog) - it can bring potential customers, it can increase websites relevance in the industry and the brand becomes an expert in providing relevant information for potential customers. Hope these help :)
